fri.so_what: The film billed as the first AI-animated feature in cinemas opens on 4 December, and its own director lists the human co-writer, editors, colourists, Foley artist and voice cast behind it: anyone pricing film work can see how much of an "AI film" is still people.
fri.story: Gods Don't Give Gifts, directed by Zack London (Gossip Goblin), opens in cinemas on 4 December 2026 as the first AI-animated feature in theatres. Film Threat describes a hybrid pipeline: London's own micron pen drawings, diffusion video models, then a co-writer, traditional editors and colourists, a Foley artist, a sound team that spent four days in a Stockholm studio on the theatrical mix, and a cast of professional voice actors. London calls the budget "absurdly small" against the $150 million a conventional version would have needed.
